title: Vernon W Simm's Ice Cream Parlor. (Later Blue Jay)
description: This later photo shows Simm’s ice-cream parlour on Main Street, with Vernon Simms standing in the doorway. Vernon developed a rich, velvety ice cream that became so popular he needed to rent extra space to keep up with demand. He sold his ice cream throughout the river valley. General Dairies eventually purchased the business, giving Vernon shares and appointing him manager in Woodstock. Vernon kept the store until 1955, when he sold it to James Miller. It later changed hands to Bob Montgomery and then Brian Hatfield. The building was demolished in 1982.
